item: Gyeongbokgung Palace & Royal Guard Changing Ceremony
originalText: Day 3: Tuesday - Gyeongbokgung Palace + Bukchon Village (Nov. 3) | 1. Gyeongbokgung Palace (... Closed: Tuesdays) | 2. changing of the guard ceremony (10:00 AM, 2:00 PM, closed on Tuesdays)
officialFinding: Per the Korea Heritage Service and VISITKOREA, Gyeongbokgung Palace and its Royal Guard Changing Ceremony are CLOSED EVERY TUESDAY. Tuesday, Nov 3, 2026 is not a Korean public holiday, so the palace gates will be locked.
recommendation: Swap Day 3 (Tuesday) with Day 6 (Friday — Ikseon-dong & Insadong) or move Gyeongbokgung Palace to open Day 8 (Sunday, Nov 8). Alternatively, visit Changdeokgung Palace & Deoksugung Palace on Tuesday (both close Mondays and are OPEN Tuesdays, with Deoksugung's Guard Ceremony at 11:00 & 14:00).
sourceTitle: Korea Heritage Service — Gyeongbokgung Palace Hours

item: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) Description vs. Seongsu-dong
originalText: 2. Dongdaemun Design Plaza or “DDP”- Industrial warehouses converted into flagship fashion pop-ups, & artisan bakeries
officialFinding: DDP (281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul) is a neo-futuristic cultural complex designed by Zaha Hadid on the former Dongdaemun Stadium site in Jung-gu. It is NOT converted industrial warehouses—that description applies to Seongsu-dong itself (e.g., Daelim Changgo, Seongsu Yeonbang, Cafe Onion Seongsu).
recommendation: If visiting DDP, stop at Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Station (Subway Line 2, 3 stops from your hotel) en route to Seongsu Station (5 more stops on Line 2). For converted industrial warehouse pop-ups & bakeries in Seongsu, visit Daelim Changgo (74 Seongsui-ro) and Seongsu Yeonbang.

originalText: Day 4: -Uri Wang Galbitang located in Gangdong. Favorite of Ikseon-dong | Day 6: 1. Chwihyang-pork belly rose pasta ... Restaurants: Favorite of Ikseon (Try pork belly rose pasta $14.50)
officialFinding: 'Ikseon Chwihyang' (익선취향, 17-32 Supyo-ro 28-gil, Jongno-gu) and 'Favorite of Ikseon' (@favorite_ikseon) are the EXACT SAME restaurant ('Favorite of Ikseon' is the English translation of 익선취향 used on Naver Maps and Instagram). It is listed twice on Day 6 for the same dish (pork belly rose pasta) and pasted as a fragment on Day 4.
recommendation: Consolidate into a single lunch or dinner stop on Day 6 in Ikseon-dong, and remove the stray 'Favorite of Ikseon-dong' text from Day 4.

item: Rain Report Cafe in Insadong & Seongsu
originalText: Day 4: Rain Report Cafe. | Day 6: 2. Rain Report Cafe in Insadong
officialFinding: Rain Report (@rainreport_official) does not have a branch in Insadong; its Jongno-gu hanok branch is 'Rain Report Rainbow' (레인리포트 레인보우) located in Ikseon-dong (33-7 Supyo-ro 28-gil, Jongno-gu). Its Seongsu branch is 'Rain Report Croissant' (32 Seongsui-ro 16-gil). Additionally, Rain Report is scheduled on both Day 4 and Day 6, and some branches have had temporary closure periods.
recommendation: Choose either Rain Report Croissant (Day 4, Seongsu) or Rain Report Rainbow (Day 6, Ikseon-dong—just 1 minute from Jayeondo Salt Bread), and check @rainreport_official before visiting.

item: Olive Young Operating Hours in Myeongdong
originalText: Cosmetics Stores: Olive Young 8:00-12:00am, Major brands 10:00-10:00pm
officialFinding: Per VISITKOREA and Olive Young's official store directory, Olive Young Myeongdong Town Global Flagship Store (53 Myeongdong-gil) operates 10:00–22:30 daily (and Myeongdong Station branch operates 10:30–22:30), NOT 08:00–24:00.
recommendation: Plan K-beauty shopping at Olive Young Myeongdong Town between 10:00 and 22:30, and bring physical passports for immediate tax refunds on purchases of 15,000 KRW or more.
sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Olive Young Myeong-dong Main Branch

item: Bukchon Hanok Village Tourist Visiting Hours Restriction
originalText: 4. Bukchon Hanok Village (traditional Korean houses). Highlight: Authentic Korean architecture, photo opportunities, craft shops
officialFinding: Per VISITKOREA and Seoul Metropolitan Government (hanok.seoul.go.kr), tourist entry into the Bukchon Hanok Village residential Red Zone (Bukchon-ro 11-gil) is strictly restricted to 10:00–17:00, with a 100,000 KRW fine imposed for violations outside those hours.
recommendation: Visit Cafe Onion Anguk first (opens 07:00 weekdays), then enter Bukchon Hanok Village strictly between 10:00 and 17:00.
sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Bukchon Tourist Entry Restriction

item: Jayeondo Sogeumppang (Salt Bread) on Day 4 and Day 6
originalText: Day 4: -Jayeondo Sogeumppang -salt bread | Day 6: 3. Jayeondo Saltbread & House ($8.77 for 4)
officialFinding: Both entries are branches of the same bakery (@saltbread.in.seaside): Jayeondo Salt Bread in Seongsu (56-1 Yeonmujang-gil) and Jayeondo Salt Bread & Jayeondoga in Ikseon-dong (21-17 Supyo-ro 28-gil). Both sell 1 item only: a 4-pack of salt bread for 12,000 KRW (~$8.77 USD), baked 6 times daily (09:00, 12:30, 14:00, 15:30, 17:00, 18:30).
recommendation: Keep one or both if you love salt bread, or substitute Soha Salt Pond (소하염전, 21-5 Supyo-ro 28-gil) in Ikseon-dong for variety.
sourceTitle: VISITSEOUL Official — Jayeondo Salt Bread in Seongsu

item: N Seoul Tower Observatory & Namsan Cable Car Hours
officialFinding: Written without AM/PM, '10:00-10:30' looks like 30 minutes. Official N Seoul Tower Observatory weekday hours are 10:00–22:30 (last entry 22:00; weekends 10:00–23:00). Official Namsan Cable Car hours are 10:00–23:00 daily (last round-trip ticket 22:30). Also, Namsan Shuttle Bus 01A/01B goes directly to the top of N Seoul Tower (1,400 KRW), so you do not need BOTH the bus and the cable car.
recommendation: Either take Bus 01A/01B round-trip (1,400 KRW each way) + Observatory ticket (29,000 KRW), OR take the Cable Car up and Bus 01A/01B down.

originalText: Day 1: Sunday -Travel from SFO to Seoul. (Oct.31/Nov 1) | Day 2: Monday -Namsun Tower & Myeongdong. (Nov 2,2006)
officialFinding: Nov 2, 2006 was a Thursday; in 2026, Saturday is Oct 31 (SFO departure), Sunday is Nov 1 (ICN arrival), and Monday is Nov 2, 2026. Additional typos in prompt: 'Namsun Tower' (Namsan / N Seoul Tower), 'Myeongdog' (Myeongdong), 'Musina Standard' (Musinsa Standard), 'pistacio' (pistachio), 'Starfiel COEX Mall' (Starfield COEX Mall), 'miuntes' (minutes).
recommendation: Corrected to 2026 dates and official Korean/English brand spellings across all dashboard tables.

item: AREX Express Train Fare ($7 Claim) & Transfer to Hotel
officialFinding: Per arex.or.kr, the AREX Express Train adult fare is 13,000 KRW (~$9.50 USD, increased from the older 9,500 KRW / ~$7 fare), and the All-Stop Train is 4,450–5,050 KRW (~$3.50 USD, 59–66 min). Moreover, AREX terminates at Seoul Station, requiring a Subway Line 4 transfer or taxi to reach Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.
recommendation: With suitcases after a long flight from SFO, Airport Limousine Bus #6015 (17,000 KRW / ~$12.50 USD) is much easier as it drops you 120m from Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.
sourceTitle: AREX Official Express Train Fare Page

item: Pig Restaurant 2 (돼지레스토랑 둘째) in Itaewon Scheduled on Myeongdong Night
originalText: Dinner: Eat at Pig Restaurant 2 - Premium Quality -Itaewon
officialFinding: Pig Restaurant 2 (14 Bogwang-ro 59-gil, Yongsan-gu) is located in Itaewon (~20 min away from Myeongdong/Gwangjang Market), while Day 7 (Saturday, Nov 7) is dedicated to Itaewon but has no restaurants listed. Also, exact hours and prices are not on an official tourism portal and are left blank.
recommendation: Dine at Myeongdong Kyoja, Crystal Jade, Hongojib, or Gwangjang Market on Day 2 (Monday), and move Pig Restaurant 2 to Day 7 (Saturday — Itaewon).

originalText: 7. Dinner- Eat at Chuncheongol Dakgalbi(unlimited lettuce and perilla wraps) -Uri Wang Galbitang located in Gangdong. Favorite of Ikseon-dong
officialFinding: Neither dinner spot is in Seongsu-dong: Chuncheongol Dakgalbi (춘천골닭갈비) has no Seongsu branch (Seoul branches are in Nowon-gu / Gangbuk-gu, 35–40 min north), and Uri Wang Galbitang (우리왕갈비탕, 119-9 Seongan-ro) is in Gangdong-gu (~30 min east of Seongsu). Neither has an official website confirming hours/prices (left blank).
recommendation: If staying in Seongsu for dinner, consider Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley or Palgakdo Seongsu (charcoal dakgalbi near Seongsu Stn), or take Line 2 → Line 5 (30 min) if specifically visiting Gangdong.

item: Gwangjang Market 'Some food stalls open until 2:00a.m.' Claim
originalText: 3. Night Market Exploration. -Myeongdog Night Food Market & Gwangjang Market-Authentic local cuisine. Netflix famous-get hand-cut noodles. Hours: 9:00-11:00pm. (Some food stalls open until 2:00a.m.)
officialFinding: Per VISITKOREA, Gwangjang Market Food Street operates 09:00–23:00 daily (general stores 09:00–18:00, closed Sundays). Food stalls do not stay open until 02:00 AM; most noodle and pancake stalls close between 21:00 and 23:00.
recommendation: Arrive at Gwangjang Market before 20:30 if you want to eat at Netflix-featured Gohyang Kalguksu (East Gate Booth #70).

item: KTX Boarding 45 Minutes Early at Seoul Station
originalText: 2. Board KTX train 45 miuntes early to secure luggage space. -Takes 2 hours and 45 minutes to get to Busan.
officialFinding: At Seoul Station, KORAIL announces KTX track/platform numbers on departure boards 15–20 minutes prior to departure, and train doors open ~15 minutes before departure after cleaning/turnaround. You cannot board a KTX train 45 minutes early.
recommendation: Arrive at Seoul Station 30–40 minutes before departure to buy snacks and wait by the concourse board, then head down to the platform as soon as your track number appears (15–20 min before departure) to secure the end-of-car luggage racks.
